task_completion.description: The human mitochondrial reference genome (NC_012920.1) is opened in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE window showing 'human_mtDNA.gb' or 'NC_012920' in the project view or sequence viewer.

task_completion.description: All 22 tRNA sequences are identified and extracted from the genome.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Selection of tRNA annotations in the UGENE sequence view or a list of 22 extracted sequences in the project pane.

task_completion.description: The extracted tRNA sequences are exported to human_mt_tRNAs.fasta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Export dialog box showing the file path '~/UGENE_Data/mitochondria/results/human_mt_tRNAs.fasta' and FASTA format selected.

task_completion.description: A multiple sequence alignment is performed on the tRNAs using the MUSCLE algorithm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The MUSCLE alignment dialog box or a progress bar for MUSCLE, followed by an alignment view (rows of sequences with gaps).

task_completion.description: The alignment result is exported to mt_tRNA_alignment.fasta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Export dialog or project pane showing 'mt_tRNA_alignment.fasta' being saved to the results directory.

task_completion.description: A summary report (tRNA_report.txt) is created with the correct tRNA count and longest sequence length.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing 'tRNA_report.txt' containing the number 22 and the length 75.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface for bioinformatics tasks rather than just command-line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with UGENE menus, dialogs, and sequence viewers.

integrity.description: The alignment was actually processed by the software, not just a pre-existing file renamed.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the MUSCLE parameters window or the alignment editor showing gaps and conservation bars.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected values into a text file without performing the extraction.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen selecting annotations or using the 'Export sequences' feature in UGENE before the report is written.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The human mitochondrial genome (NC_012920.1) contains exactly 22 tRNA genes. The shortest tRNA is 59 bp and the longest tRNA is 75 bp (tRNA-Leu). The final report must state 22 tRNAs and a maximum length of 75 bp to be considered correct.
